meaning: Every row of the October teardown ledgers and comparison matrices, each accounted for as an existing concept, a proposed (pending) concept or an explicit exclusion with its kind and reason. The denominator for the union of execution concepts.

rows.summary: Pinned releases of the plugin, weave library, span SDK and Claude Code; plugin renamed and relicensed.

exclusion.reason: Release identity and licence only; carried into the integration record, not an information item.

rows.summary: Capture mechanism: hooks to a RAM-only daemon to OTLP export; tool data from hook payloads, assistant content from transcript reverse-read.

exclusion.reason: Describes how the integration acquires data; its per-item consequences are recorded as observations.

rows.summary: June span-name claim refuted: rows are invoke_agent/chat/execute_tool; session is an attribute; permission is a span event.

exclusion.reason: Span naming and tree shape of one integration; identity items are mapped through the matrix rows.

rows.summary: Reported cost omitted by the plugin; Claude Code reports cost only at session/model scope (cost-state, stream result).
Backend computes cost at query time from tokens times a price table; never stored.

exclusion.reason: Calculated cost is a backend price-table derivation, not a reported execution fact.

rows.summary: Sub-agent interiors are fully captured (whole sidechain parsed); June first-line claim refuted.
Sub-agent link: parent span, agent id equal to sidechain agentId, spawning tool call id as a custom attribute.
Async sub-agent: parent output is a launch stub; the background notification opens a second root trace with no typed prompt.
Thinking blocks with empty text and a signature are dropped entirely (no part, signature or placeholder).
redacted_thinking becomes a "[redacted]" placeholder part without its opaque data.
Reasoning tokens exported as 0: plugin reads a field Claude Code does not write (output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens).
Per-response usage exact; input is the sum of uncached and cache counters; no usage on turn/session rows.
Stream-json assistant events carry provisional output_tokens; final values are in the transcript, message_delta and result.
Cache TTL split, service_tier, speed, inference_geo, iterations and server_tool_use counters not exported.
Every transcript tool_use has exactly one tool row with deep-equal arguments and a result; repeated names stay distinct by id.
Stored tool result is the hook tool_response JSON, not the model-visible tool_result text (equal in 1 of 6).
Tool arguments/results are re-serialized server-side (2.50 becomes 2.5); credential-named keys redacted; large result kept.
Text/tool_call order within a response preserved; tool rows are siblings of chat rows; turn output is joined text.
Typed prompt text captured; attachments/images/files not; system instructions only via InstructionsLoaded.
Schema supports blob/uri/file parts and content refs; plugin emits only text/thinking/tool_use.
One response split across transcript records is folded by message.id into one final row; sent spans are immutable.
Failed tool becomes status ERROR with a coarse error type and the error text as result.
SIGTERM interrupt: open call closed as session_ended with no result; partial output exists only in the transcript; root UNSET.
Manual permission denial: request recorded as a span event, decision and denial text absent, call mislabelled incomplete with a wrong duration.
Auto-mode PermissionDenied hook yields request and resolved(approved=false) events and error type permission_denied.
Permission events live only in the events dump (no column).
Daemon SIGKILL loses open spans and the root; completed children exported with an absent parent.
Daemon SIGTERM closes open work as daemon_shutdown and flushes.
Hook payloads over 4 MiB are dropped silently; the completed tool is recorded as incomplete with no result.
Turn root span stays open until the next prompt or SessionEnd, so its duration is not the run duration; native durations not exported.
Child spans are exported before the root; readers must tolerate dangling parents.

exclusion.reason: Export ordering of one integration; not an information item of the execution.

rows.summary: Request model is set from the response model value; requestedModel dropped; provider guessed from the id prefix.

Sub-agent spans carry agent_id/parent_agent_id and nest under the Agent tool span; transcript meta.json and wire task events also link the child.

Successful tool output is in the normalized record (all tool calls on pairs A-D).
Assistant text absent from the normalized record at the refresh (later closed).
Block order not recoverable at the refresh (later closed).
Thinking text kept; signature, display mode and duration dropped at the refresh (signature later closed).
Sub-agents recorded as linked child runs; sidechain meta (agentType, description, spawnDepth, finished) not captured.
Permission decisions present on stream and transcript, absent from Level 1 at the refresh (later closed).
Reported cost total written into inputCostUsd with other components 0; validity flags missing on the main call.
Usage recorded at run scope with per-turn and per-model detail; transcript per-iteration usage not read.
Stream system init inventory and result details retained whole as vendor events, not typed.
rate_limit_event lines not preserved until an SDK release.
